z-m-30-01.title: Kulandela ini ngemva kuka-1, 2, 4?
z-m-30-01.topic: Amandla e-matrix: zingaki izinombolo ezidingekayo ukunquma iphethini?
z-m-30-01.goal: Qonda ukuthi emandleni e-matrix, imithetho eminingana ingafaneleka kumanani ambalwa, hlunga imithetho engenzeka futhi ubuyekeze isahlulelo sakho njengoba usebenza, futhi uchaze ukuthi ungaqiniseka ngefomula ejwayelekile kuphela ngemva kokuthola isizathu (isakhiwo).
z-m-30-01.material: U-B yi-matrix engu-2×2, futhi amanani ayo amane (umugqa 1 inkolo 1, umugqa 1 inkolo 2, umugqa 2 inkolo 1, umugqa 2 inkolo 2) wonke angu-1. U-B^n yi-matrix oyithola ngokuphindaphinda u-B izikhathi ezingu-n. Wonke amanani ayizinombolo zangempela futhi u-n uyinombolo ephelele engu-1 noma ngaphezulu. Abangani ababili baxoxa ngamanani ka-B³. Oyedwa uthi, "Amanani ka-B¹ no-B² angu-1 no-2, ngakho u-B³ ungu-3," futhi omunye uthi, "Angiqinisekile okwamanje. Ake siphindaphinde okwengeziwe." Njalo uma idatha imbulwa, buyekeza isahlulelo sakho noma ukugcine.
z-m-30-01.thinking.0: Uma ujwayelekisa umthetho kusukela kudatha encane, cabanga nangezinye izimiso ezingenzeka
z-m-30-01.thinking.1: Ukulungisa isahlulelo sakho nezinga lokuzethemba ngokwesidingo solwazi olusha
z-m-30-01.thinking.2: Ukuthola umugqa wokuqala ohamba kabi esixazululweni nokuchaza imbangela
z-m-30-01.thinking.3: Ukwenza ifomula ejwayelekile usebenzisa izinhlamvu (p, n) nokubhala isizathu
z-m-30-01.prereq.0: Ukuphindaphinda kwama-matrix angu-2×2 (inani elilodwa lomkhiqizo = isamba semikhiqizo yamanani omugqa owodwa we-matrix engaphambili nenkolo eyodwa ye-matrix engemuva) namandla u-A^n = u-A ophindaphindwe izikhathi ezingu-n
z-m-30-01.prereq.1: Ukufunda izisho eziqukethe izinhlamvu u-n no-p nokuthola amaphethini alula ezinombolo
z-m-30-01.prereq.2: Isicabango sokulandelana kwesikole: i-H2 yalo msebenzi iyilebula yobunzima kuphela ekukhiqizweni futhi akusho ukuthi uMnyango Wezemfundo wabela lokhu okuqukethwe ebangeni elithile. Sicabanga ukuthi kuza ngokushesha ngemva kokufunda ukuphindaphinda kwama-matrix, futhi i-induction noma ama-determinant akudingeki.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.prompt: Idatha imbulwa isinyathelo ngesinyathelo. Esinyathelweni ngasinye, khetha isahlulelo sakho samanje mayelana nokuthi amanani wamandla ka-B azoba yini.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.hint.0: Esinyathelweni ngasinye, bhala yonke imithetho efanelana nezinombolo kuze kube manje, futhi uqhathanise ukuthi yimuphi walokho olusha lukhipha.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi ukhethe ngokucabanga umthetho owodwa kuphela, noma ucabange nangezinye izimiso.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.info: U-B¹ nguB ngokwakhe, ngakho wonke amanani amane angu-1. Uma u-B² waphindaphindwa ngqo, wonke amanani amane abe ngu-2.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.ask: Kuthiwani ngamanani ka-B³? Khetha isahlulelo sakho samanje.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Izingcezu ezimbili zedatha zichaza kokubili u-3 no-4. Ungathatha umthetho owodwa njengo-'mcabango osebenzayo,' kodwa ngaphambi kokuhlola kunengqondo ukugcina isahlulelo sakho sivulekile.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Wonke amanani angu-3. Ngemva kuka-1, 2, umthetho wokwanda ngo-1 uyaqhubeka
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Kukhona imithetho efanelana no-1, 2 ngaphandle kwe-'ukwanda ngo-1.' Ngamaphoyinti amabili edatha kuphela, kusekuseni ukunquma umthetho owodwa.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Wonke amanani angu-4. Ngemva kuka-1, 2, umthetho wokuphindaphinda kabili uyaqhubeka
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Umthetho wokuphindwa kabili nawo uyahambisana no-1, 2, kodwa kanjalo no-'ukwenyuka ngo-1.' Qaphela ukuthi kusenesikhathi sokukhetha oyedwa kuphela futhi uqiniseke.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Asikwazi ukunquma phakathi kuka-3 no-4 okwamanje, ngakho hlola ngokuphindaphinda u-B³ ngqo
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ubone ukuthi amaphoyinti edatha amabili ahambisana nemithetho eminingana futhi walibazisa isahlulelo sakho. Ucabange nangesenzo sokuhlola (ukuphindaphinda ngqo).
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Zonke izinombolo zingu-2. Iyi-matrix enazo zonke izinombolo ezifanayo, ngakho inani aliguquki futhi
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Ku-B², inani selivele laguquka lisuka ku-1 laya ku-2. Ukuthi izinombolo ziyafana akusho ukuthi inani aliguquki.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.info: Uma u-B³ waphindaphindwa ngqo, zonke izinombolo ezine zingu-4. Kuze kube manje kungu-1, 2, 4. Umthetho ohambisana nalezi zinombolo akusilo nje 'ukuphindwa kabili.' Ukwengeza amanani amabili edlule bese wengeza u-1 kunika u-1, 2, 4, 7, ..., futhi lokhu nakho kuyahambisana.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.after: Ngenxa luka-B³, 'ukwenyuka ngo-1' kususiwe. Kodwa umthetho wokuphindwa kabili nomthetho ongu-1, 2, 4, 7 awukwazi ukuhlukaniswa kuze kubalwe u-B⁴. Udinga ukuqoqa idatha eyengeziwe noma uthole isizathu.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Nquma ngomthetho wokuphindwa kabili bese ubhala ukuthi zonke izinombolo zika-B⁴ zingu-8
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Kuyiqiniso ukuthi amanani amathathu ahambisana nokuphindwa kabili, kodwa umthetho ongu-1, 2, 4, 7 nawo uyahambisana. Awukawahlukanisi amabili.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Thatha u-4 luka-B³ njengephutha lokubala bese ugcina umthetho wokuqala wokuthi zonke zingu-3
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Uma ukhomba inani elibalwe ngqo njengephutha, ungagcina isahlulelo sakho sokuqala kodwa awunasisekelo. Ukuhlola futhi ukubala kuhlukile ekulahleni.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Kunemithetho eminingana, ngakho ungaqageli nhlobo kule datha
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: 'Ukwenyuka ngo-1' akusahambisani. Ukuthi imithetho esele ncipha ngenani nakho kuyulwazi.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Lahla u-'ukwenyuka ngo-1,' bese uhlunga imithetho emibili esele nge-B⁴
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Ulahle umthetho ongahambisani nedatha futhi wacabanga nangendlela yokuhlukanisa imithetho esele.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.info: Ngifune isizathu. Ake zonke izinombolo ezine zika-B^n zibe yinombolo efanayo u-k. Inombolo eyodwa luka-B^(n+1) = B^n × B ngu-(k × 1) + (k × 1) = 2k. Kuyafana ukubala ezinombolweni zonke ezine. Zonke izinombolo zika-B¹ zingu-1.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.ask: Manje uhlulela kanjani izinombolo zika-B^n no-B⁵?
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.after: Umumo lapho zonke izinombolo zifana ugcinwa isikhathi ngasinye futhi inani liphindwa kabili, ngakho izinombolo zika-B^n zingu-2^(n−1). Isahlulelo esasishiywe sivulekile ekuqaleni njengo-'ukuthi ngu-3 noma u-4' sancipha ngokulandelana kwedatha → imithetho ehlongozwayo → isizathu. Umfundi obale u-B⁴ ngqo ufinyelela esiphethweni esifanayo.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Izinombolo zika-B^n zonke zingu-n, nezika-B⁵ zonke zingu-5
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Umthetho ka-n usuvele waphuma ku-B³. Awuhambisani nolwazi olusha (2k isikhathi ngasinye lapho siphindaphinda).
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Izinombolo zika-B^n zonke zingu-2^(n−1), nezika-B⁵ zonke zingu-16
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Uxhumanise konke kuze kube yisizathu sokuthi 'ukuphindaphinda ngakunye kunika u-2k' kusebenza kuwo wonke u-n.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Kungenzeka kube ngu-2^(n−1), kodwa angiyikuqiniseka ngaphambi kokuphindaphinda u-B⁵ ngqo
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Isimo sokufuna ukuhlola siyinhle. Kodwa ulwazi olusha lusizathu esisebenza kunoma yimuphi u-n. Cabanga ukuthi leso sizathu sithinta kanjani ukuzethemba kwakho.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.o.d: U-B⁴ ungu-7, ngakho u-B⁵ konke ngu-12
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ugcine umthetho ongu-1, 2, 4, 7. Hlola ukuthi uhambisana yini nolwazi olusha lokuthi u-k uba ngu-2k.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.reflect: Kusukela ekulibazisweni kwesahlulelo ekuqaleni kuya ekuthembeni ekugcineni, yini eguqule ukuzethemba kwakho? Kwenza umehluko muni ekuzetheni kwakho ukuqoqa amaphoyinti edatha amathathu angeziwe nokuthola u-'isizathu'?
z-m-30-01.s.s2.prompt: UHayun, osebenza naye eklasini, wathola izinombolo zamandla ka-C = 3B (i-matrix ezine zazo zonke izinombolo ezingu-3) njengaphansi. Khetha umugqa wokuqala ophosile.
z-m-30-01.s.s2.hint.0: Khetha eyodwa yezinombolo zika-C bese ubala ngqo inombolo (umugqa 1, ikholomu 1) luka-C eliphindaphindwe nga-yo kabili.
z-m-30-01.s.s2.hint.1: Qhathanisa inani elibalwe ngqo nenani emgqeni ngamunye bese uthola umugqa wokuqala lapho behluka khona.
z-m-30-01.s.s2.line.1: Zonke izinombolo zika-B² zingu-2, ngakho zonke izinombolo zika-C² zingu-3 × 2 = 6.
z-m-30-01.s.s2.line.2: Ngendlela efanayo C³ = 3B³, futhi zonke izinombolo zika-B³ zingu-4, ngakho zonke izinombolo zika-C³ zingu-3 × 4 = 12.
z-m-30-01.s.s2.explain: Emgqeni 1, okungaguquki u-3 kukhona kanye kwisici ngasinye sezimbili, kodwa kukhishwe kanye kuphela. Ku-(3B)(3B) u-3 uvela kabili, ngakho u-C² = 9B², futhi zonke izinombolo zingu-9 × 2 = 18. Uma wenza isikwele luka-C ngqo bese ubala inombolo eyodwa kuphela, 3×3 + 3×3 = 18, ngakho ungaqinisekisa ukuthi ihlukile ku-6. Imigqa 2 kuya ku-4 ithole isisho somugqa 1 futhi iphosile. Umugqa 3 nawo, ngesizathu esifanayo: C³ = 27B³ futhi izinombolo zingu-108.
z-m-30-01.s.s3.prompt: Kulokhu, cabanga nge-matrix u-P enazo zonke izinombolo ezine ezingu-p (u-p uyinombolo ephelele eyiphozithivu). Veza izinombolo zika-P^n, u-P ophindaphindwe izikhathi ezingu-n, ngo-p no-n, bese ubhala ukuthi kungani ungasho kanjalo.
z-m-30-01.s.s3.hint.0: Kwa-p=1 no-p=2, phindaphinda u-P² ngqo bese uqhathanisa izinombolo.
z-m-30-01.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala njengesisho ukuthi izinombolo zika-P² zixhumene kanjani nezinombolo zika-P no-p, bese uhlola ukuthi into efanayo yenzeka ku-P³.
z-m-30-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe inombolo u-2^(n−1) luka-B^n iphuma futhi esishweni sami uma u-p=1?
z-m-30-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngihlole ukuthi ihambisana namanani aphindaphindwe ngqo ngokufaka u-n=1 no-n=2?
z-m-30-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ngibhale ithambo lesizathu, njengo-'kungani ukubala inombolo eyodwa kwanele' noma 'ngokukhipha u-B'?
z-m-30-01.s.s3.model.0: Izinombolo zika-P^n zonke zingu-p^n × 2^(n−1). Uma sibhala u-P = pB, khona-ke u-P^n = p^n B^n, futhi izinombolo zika-B^n ziphindwa kabili isikhathi ngasinye.
z-m-30-01.s.s3.model.1: Njengo-p, 2p², 4p³, ..., izinombolo ziba ngu-2p izikhathi ezinkulu isikhathi ngasinye lapho siphindaphinda kanye. Izinombolo ezine zigcina umumo ofanayo futhi inombolo eyodwa ngu-p×k + p×k = 2pk, ngakho izinombolo zika-P^n zingu-p × (2p)^(n−1).
z-m-30-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Indlela eqala ekuguqukeni kokuphindaphinda kanye. Isisho siyafana nempendulo edlule.
